title: Sustainability Infographic
headline: Sustainability & Regenerative Design Case Studies
description:
These two four-foot-tall posters were designed using content developed by our sustainability and marketing team. They cover Via Verde, a South Bronx affordable housing scheme, and the Dubai Expo 2020 Sustainability Pavilion. Each pairs a hero image and title with large key metrics, UN Sustainable Development Goals, and a detailed axonometric diagram that turns technical content into a clear, scannable layout. The posters are currently on display at Grimshaw's New York office.

Click, pan, and zoom to explore the poster up close. (Works better on desktop)
